ticket.subject: Re: SSO login loop for our team
ticket.body_text:
Hi Sam Ortega,

Great, that worked, everyone can sign in with SSO again. While I have you: our September invoice still charges for the SSO add-on, which we cancelled in August. Can you credit it this week?

Thanks,
Jonas

On Fri, 18 Sep 2026 at 22:30, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
> Thanks for the details. Your identity provider was sending the email address
> in a different attribute after your change. I have updated the mapping on
> our side. Could you ask one of your users to sign out and sign in again with
> SSO and let me know if the loop is gone?

> On Thu, 17 Sep 2026 at 21:23, Jonas Okonkwo wrote:
>> Since this morning, everyone who signs in with SSO ends up in a loop: they
>> log in at our identity provider, come back to your login page, and start
>> again. Password login still works for the two admins. We changed the
>> identity provider settings last week, but nothing related to your app as far
>> as we know.

>> On Wed, 16 Sep 2026 at 20:16, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
>>> Hello, thanks for reaching out. Could you send us the time of a failed sign-
>>> in and the name of the identity provider you use? That helps us find the
>>> right log entries.

label_notes: thread_quoted: the quoted history is an access problem (SSO loop) that is now solved; the new message asks for a credit on an invoice, so billing P3; 'this week' = medium.
